question:
The given equation provides the property of the motion of an object, traversing a circular path. What is ‘v’ in this equation?

ac = v²/R
solution:
The correct answer is __**Speed.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The equation** ac = v²/R** provides the **centripetal acceleration** of an object moving in a **circular path.**
 
• Here, 'v' represents the **speed or velocity** of the object.
 
• The unit of speed is** meters per second** (m/s) or **kilometers per hour** (km/h).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Distance** is the** total length **covered by an object in motion and is measured in** meters (m) or kilometers (km).**
 
• **Surface area **is the total area occupied by the** surface of an object **and is measured in **square units **like square meters (m²) or square centimeters (cm²).
 
• **Intensity **is the measure of the** strength or power **of a phenomenon such as light, sound, or radiation and is measured in units like** watts per square meter (W/m²) or decibels (dB).**
